floater.name: water_options
floater.title: WATER EFFECTS
floater.text: Turn water effects on or off. An effect that is off does no work, so switching one off can only save frame time.

combo_box.name: water_waves
combo_box.tool_tip: Wave quality. Off is flat water. Low uses a coarser mesh near the camera; High costs a little more GPU time on big water.

slider.label: Wave intensity
slider.name: water_wave_intensity
slider.tool_tip: How big the sea is: 0 is glassy calm, 1 is as the wind and weather make it, 2 is double the wave height. Scales the wave heights, the wind ripples, the surf and the foam. Needs Waves on. No performance cost.

slider.label: Foam
slider.name: water_foam
slider.tool_tip: The foam where water meets shores, rocks, piers and legs, plus the surf and whitecaps. 0 turns all foam off (no foam work is done), 1 is the default, 2 is twice the coverage. Small GPU cost, higher with more foam on screen.

check_box.label: Whitecaps and surf lines
check_box.name: water_whitecaps
check_box.tool_tip: Foam on the wave crests and the breaking lines on beaches. Off keeps only the foam where water touches things. Needs Waves on, Foam above 0 and water interaction at Medium or higher. Off skips that shader work; the shoreline band stays (its foam pattern is a little plainer).

combo_box.name: water_interaction
combo_box.tool_tip: How much the water reacts to avatars and objects. Off frees its memory. Low is foam and splashes only. Medium adds ripples. High has finer ripples (a bigger field, more GPU and video memory). Cards under 4.5 GB of video memory run at most Medium.

check_box.label: Ripples from avatars and objects
check_box.name: water_ripples
check_box.tool_tip: Rings spread from wading, landing, falling in and moving objects. Off frees the ripple field (2 to 8 MB of video memory) and its per-frame compute pass. Needs water interaction at Medium or higher.

check_box.label: Splashes from avatars and objects
check_box.name: water_splashes
check_box.tool_tip: Spray particles when something enters, wades through or leaves the water. Off draws no droplets. Needs water interaction above Off.

check_box.label: Rain ripples (wet ground)
check_box.name: water_rain_ripples
check_box.tool_tip: Animated rain ripples on wet, flat, sky-exposed surfaces such as puddles (not only water). Off skips them. Small GPU cost during rain.

check_box.label: Rain splashes (ground, roofs, water)
check_box.name: water_rain_splashes
check_box.tool_tip: Small splashes where raindrops hit the ground, roofs and water near you. Off spawns none. Small GPU cost during rain.

check_box.label: Underwater sun and moon caustics
check_box.name: water_caustics
check_box.tool_tip: Moving light patterns on submerged opaque surfaces. Follows the waves and water detail; fades in shade and deep water. Needs transparent water and sun/moon shadows. Off skips the caustic work.

floater.text: Transparent water is under Advanced Graphics Preferences.
